editorial:
Ever feel like the universe is just against you? That is exactly what you get with this classic cartoon. You have Wile E. Coyote, a hungry genius who thinks he can outsmart a fast bird, and the Road Runner, who just wants to keep zooming. It is a wild ride filled with crazy inventions and a lot of bad luck. The vibe is pure chaos in the best way possible, and you will find yourself laughing at how everything that could go wrong definitely does go wrong for the poor coyote.

What really makes this one work is the timing. The way the gadgets fail is perfectly played, especially when the painted bridge trick backfires. The pacing is snappy, so you never get bored. If you love slapstick humor where characters get flattened like pancakes, you will love this. It is a quick watch, but it packs a punch. You should definitely check it out by streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the crispest colors, or just grab the 4K Blu-ray to keep in your physical collection for movie nights with the family.
endingExplained: The final scenes show Wile E. Coyote trying one last desperate plan with a powerful jet motor. He thinks he finally has the speed to catch the Road Runner, but the motor is way too strong. Instead of catching his prey, he blasts himself right into a rock wall. The short ends with the Road Runner zooming away with a loud beep-beep, leaving the crushed coyote behind in the dust once again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic cartoons and slapstick comedy.
